svg.title: UAM proof-gate dependency map
svg.desc: All sixteen aggregate proof gates. Arrows show hard pass dependencies. Every gate is open and every owner is unassigned.

a.aria-label: G0 Fictional evidence foundation; gate open; owner UNASSIGNED

g.title: Deterministic classified fictional evidence, strict contracts, an independent oracle, mutation detection, privacy-canary containment, cleanup, and independently recomputable gate evidence all work together. Research complete; ADR experimenting; implementation not-started

a.aria-label: G1 Windows session and process isolation; gate open; owner UNASSIGNED

g.title: The correct User Host starts in each session, identity and release are bound to every message, IPC rejects peers and other sessions, and hostile Task Host work stays contained. Research complete; ADR not-created; implementation blocked

text.tspan: The correct User Host starts in each

a.aria-label: G2 Safe Edge acquisition; gate open; owner UNASSIGNED

g.title: Direct read, SQLite backup, or safe defer is selected correctly with zero source writes, bounded impact, and no raw-data escape. Research complete; ADR not-created; implementation blocked

text.tspan: Direct read, SQLite backup, or safe

a.aria-label: G3 Source and cursor correctness; gate open; owner UNASSIGNED

g.title: Discovery is bounded, source replacement is detected, native identifiers control progress, and duplicates have one effect. Research complete; ADR not-created; implementation blocked

a.aria-label: G4 Privacy transformation; gate open; owner UNASSIGNED

g.title: The host applies a strict ceiling, hard denies, deterministic matching, realm isolation, and canary scanning before data crosses its trust boundary. Research complete; ADR not-created; implementation blocked

text.tspan: The host applies a strict ceiling,

a.aria-label: G5 Crash-safe endpoint outbox; gate open; owner UNASSIGNED

g.title: One writer atomically records effect and progress, sealed batches replay unchanged, and cleanup waits for a valid receipt. Research complete; ADR not-created; implementation blocked

a.aria-label: AG-06 Authorized release and rollback; gate open; owner UNASSIGNED

g.title: The same digest is authorized end to end; install, repair, update, downgrade denial, and N/N-1 rollback leave no mixed or privileged residue. Research complete; ADR not-created; implementation blocked

text.tspan: The same digest is authorized end to

a.aria-label: AG-07 Device identity and network; gate open; owner UNASSIGNED

g.title: Enrollment, renewal, cloning, revocation, wrong-realm denial, proxy/VPN behavior, and direct mTLS fail safely. Research complete; ADR not-created; implementation blocked

a.aria-label: AG-08 Safe diagnostics and platform tuple; gate open; owner UNASSIGNED

g.title: Only bounded structured signals are emitted; temporary diagnostics expire; no arbitrary command/file access exists; compatibility claims name exact evidence. Research complete; ADR not-created; implementation blocked

a.aria-label: AG-09 Durable server inbox; gate open; owner UNASSIGNED

g.title: Receipt follows atomic durable bytes, leases are fenced, duplicate events have one effect, and poison handling is bounded. Research complete; ADR not-created; implementation blocked

a.aria-label: AG-10 Database and capacity; gate open; owner UNASSIGNED

g.title: Candidate databases preserve required semantics and recovery while the measured workload stays within explicit objectives and headroom. Research complete; ADR not-created; implementation blocked

a.aria-label: AG-11 Backpressure and long outage; gate open; owner UNASSIGNED

g.title: Pressure causes bounded pause and visible recovery, not unacknowledged drop, corruption, uncontrolled growth, or false health. Research complete; ADR not-created; implementation blocked

a.aria-label: AG-12 Lifecycle, restore, and extended Windows; gate open; owner UNASSIGNED

g.title: Tombstones and acknowledgements reconcile before reads resume, and no unsupported platform tuple is claimed. Research complete; ADR not-created; implementation blocked

a.aria-label: AG-13 Portal authorization and audit; gate open; owner UNASSIGNED

g.title: The complete route catalogue enforces approved capability rules, JIT and approval state, audit-before-disclosure, tamper evidence, and accessible critical workflows. Research complete; ADR not-created; implementation blocked

a.aria-label: AG-14 Migration discovery and comparison; gate open; owner UNASSIGNED

g.title: The estate is bounded, mismatches have owned dispositions, configuration is explicit, and shadow data cannot become ordinary output. Research complete; ADR not-created; implementation blocked

a.aria-label: AG-15 Cutover and decommissioning; gate open; owner UNASSIGNED

g.title: There is one unambiguous writer at every stage, rollback boundaries are explicit, legacy credentials and write paths are removed, and residual attempts are detected and handled. Research complete; ADR not-created; implementation blocked
